subject: GCP co-sell sprint plan + critical-path items for Quantum Health listing
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@quantumhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: GCP PM <gcp-pm@google.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: GCP listing + co-sell runway (Quantum Health)

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the demo last week. Quantum Health is excited about moving toward a marketplace listing and coordinating co-sell support from the GCP field. Two asks to kick off: 1) a short sprint plan (2 weeks) that maps owners for listing artifacts (security, billing, listing copy, testing), and 2) a shared view of the joint pipeline so my sales ops and your partner team can prioritize the items GCP needs for co-sell funding.

I attached a simple pipeline sheet (pipeline_sheet_QH.xlsx) with our current milestones and asked fields. Can you confirm who will own the GCP playbook artifacts and the date you can deliver the SOC2 evidence snapshot?

Proposed call window: Wed Aug 4 (PST) 10:00–11:00 or Thu Aug 5 14:00–15:00 PT.

Thanks — looking to get the ball rolling so we can hit GCP listing cutoff next sprint.

Sanjay Patel
Sr. Solutions Director, Quantum Health
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@quantumhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: GCP listing + co-sell runway (Quantum Health)

Team —

Looping you in to own the internal pieces. Quick plan below (2-week sprint):

- Ben: Partner PM lead — own GCP readiness checklist, coordinate with GCP PM on co-sell funding intake. Deliverable: compiled checklist + playbook page by Fri Aug 6 EOD.
- Vanessa: Marketplace listing artifacts — pricing table, marketing blurb, listing images. Deliverable: draft listing content by Mon Aug 9.
- Karthik: Product/eng intake — confirm SOC2 snapshot, retention policy, and any runtime isolation notes for Private deployments. Deliverable: SOC2 attestation + short implementation notes by Wed Aug 11.

Ben/Vanessa: please update the attached pipeline_sheet_QH.xlsx with owner columns populated and any open blockers. I’ll book a 30-min working session with Sanjay and the GCP PM once we have the checklist and a short list of blockers.

Cc’d Sanjay so he sees owners. If anyone needs me to escalate a resource request (security evidence, legal review), flag it here by EOD Tue.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123

--
Attachment: pipeline_sheet_QH.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@quantumhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: GCP listing + co-sell runway (Quantum Health)

Thanks Grace — quick status and blockers: 

1) Checklist: will have a first-pass checklist by end of day Thu Aug 5.
2) Billing contact: Quantum Health procurement contact is not on this thread (Sanjay, can you introduce Maria (procurement)? We need the billing/legal contact for the marketplace contract template).
3) SOC2 evidence: Karthik, can you confirm which SOC2 snapshot (date/version) we can share? Legal prefers a recent PDF rather than portal link.
4) GCP playbook: I’ll pick up the co-sell intake form and loop with GCP PM to confirm funding eligibility — need to confirm who on the GCP side will submit the intake.

Proposed working session: Thu Aug 5 10:00–10:30 PT to go through checklist and blockers. If GCP PM can join, great — otherwise we’ll capture notes and share.

Ben Carter
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Hi all — thanks for the clear plan. A few quick notes from the GCP side and next steps: 

- Co-sell intake: I can submit the intake but need the compiled readiness checklist and a link to the SOC2 PDF. Once I have those items, I can confirm funding eligibility within our next co-sell cycle (decision window is Aug 12–14).
- Procurement: please add Maria (maria.lopez@quantumhealth.com) on the thread for billing/contract templates. Sanjay, can you introduce?
- Playbook items: GCP requires a short runbook (1–2 pages) describing typical request flows and expected latencies for the Redwood hosted API. If you can draft this (Ben/Karthik), we can attach to the intake.
- Proposed joint working session: Wed Aug 11 09:00–09:45 PT (30–45 min). If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and the HubSpot co-sell intake link.

I’ve also left a HubSpot note (linked) on the deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/RDW-7890 — please reference the deal id RDW-7890 when you submit artifacts.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this into the intake window.
